# Implementation Plan - Create planned.txt

## Goal Description
Create a new file named `planned.txt` in the workspace root directory containing the text `hi`.

## User Review Required
> [!NOTE]
> Simple creation of a single text file. No breaking changes or special permissions required.

```text
